articles.title: Ventures Platform goes bigger — and broader — with its second Africa fund

articles.summary: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."

articles.title: X sends cease-and-desist to open source project Nitter over alleged scraping

articles.title: Instagram’s ‘First Draft’ feature aims to make editing Reels less tedious

articles.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding

articles.summary: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

articles.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat

articles.title: Waymo robotaxis are headed to Munich
articles.summary: Germany's autonomous vehicle regulations have made it a hotspot for autonomous vehicle testing and eventual commercial robotaxi deployment.

articles.title: Life360 expands pet tracking with new $8 scannable tags and zoomie alerts
articles.summary: Life360’s new $7.99 scannable pet tags alert families when a lost pet is found and share its last known location, while new care-tracking features help households keep tabs on feeding, walks, medication, and more.
